name: s81b-selt_c-slat4-mm2-9ac26e269-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): s81b-selt_c-slat4-mm2-9ac26e269 re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: selt_c MRG_PIPE + RQPIPE + SLAT 4 (the control for PIPE2 quarter tiles) | flow-hold mm route-time hold repair (SS setup + FF hold, HM 50 ps at FF)

bench.name: exact_pipe2
bench.cmd: command -v verilator >/dev/null && JOBS=8 bash tools/s81_ph/selt_pipeline_bench.sh {RUN}/bench p2 1 -GMRG_PIPE=1 -GRQPIPE=1 -GPIPE2=1 -GSLAT=4 -GCMP_RETIME=1

bench.name: neg_threshold
bench.cmd: command -v verilator >/dev/null && JOBS=8 bash tools/s81_ph/selt_pipeline_bench.sh {RUN}/bench mt 1 -GMRG_PIPE=1 -GRQPIPE=1 -GPIPE2=1 -GSLAT=4 -GCMP_RETIME=1  +define+S81PH_MUT_THRESHOLD
